produced_findings.claim: Page slice returns one extra item, overlapping adjacent pages `end = offset + page_size + 1` makes the slice `items[offset:offset + page_size + 1]`, which has `page_size + 1` elements whenever enough items remain. For `items = range(10)` and `page_size = 3`, page 1 is `[0, 1, 2, 3]` and page 2 is `[3, 4, 5, 6]`, so item 3 appears on both pages. The pre-image `items[offset : offset + page_size]` returned exactly `page_size` items. Every page returns more items than requested, and the last item of each page is repeated as the first item of the next page. Callers that render or process pages get duplicated records, and any caller that assumes `len(page) <= page_size` breaks.
